items.claim: Escape mid-sweep, then the release's click toggles the pressed segment
items.note: The reviewers' premise was wrong as written: Escape never cancelled a segment sweep, because the sweep's dispatcher runs with `keyboard: false`, even though the `sweep` docs say Escape restores the segments. edea9160c4 makes Escape cancel the sweep. 3aba748466 keeps the click guard up after any cancel with the button still held (window blur, or now Escape) until the pointer is released. It is shared with ToggleChips and CheckboxGroup.

items.note: React matches a top-level unkeyed fragment's first child by index and reuses the `Disabled` scope. A test showed the segment buttons kept the same nodes before any change.
